howto.goal: Sink all five of the other fleet's ships before they sink yours.
howto.setup: Two 10 by 10 seas. Each side hides five ships, from a carrier of five squares down to a destroyer of two. White lays out first.

sections.title: Laying out
sections.text: Drag a ship from the tray onto your waters, or click it first to turn it. Ships lie across or down, and they cannot overlap.

sections.title: Firing
sections.text: Click a square in the other fleet's water. A red ring is a hit and a pale dot is a miss.

sections.title: Sinking
sections.text: A ship sinks when every one of its squares has been hit. Sink all five to win.

controls: Drag a ship from the tray onto your waters; a click turns it. Press Random to lay out the whole fleet.
Click a square in the enemy water to fire.
Press Look after handing the screen to another person.

frames.say: A ship laid across the middle.
A hit fills the square; a miss is a pale dot.
Hit every square of a ship to sink it.

demo.intro: Both fleets use the same published layout, mirrored. White hunts the black fleet, then black answers.

lines.say: Both seas are hidden. White lays out first, then black.
White lays down the published five-ship fleet.
Black mirrors the same fleet, left to right, so both start equal.
White fires into the middle at e5. Nothing is there: a miss.
Black fires at the same square in white's sea. Also a miss.
White fires at j1 and hits the black carrier.
Black answers at a1 and hits white's carrier.
White hits the battleship at j3.
Black hits back at a3. Both sides now know where to hunt.

demo.outro: Once you get a hit, fire along that row or column. Sink all five ships to win.

steps.say: Drag a ship from the tray onto a square of your waters; a click turns it. Random lays out the whole fleet.
Click a square in the enemy water to fire. A red ring means you hit a ship.
After a hit, fire at the squares next to it: ships lie in straight lines.
Press Look when you pass the screen. It stays covered until the next person looks.
